name: FDH Electronics
old_description: We are a fully franchised value-added distributor for the world’s leading manufacturers of electrical products
about:
FDH Electronics operates from Naugatuck, Connecticut, as a division of FDH Aero. The company functions as a fully franchised value-added distributor for leading manufacturers of electrical products, with leadership including Interim President Bob Earley, CFO Chris Mascarenhas, and supply chain executive Mitch Enright.

The company combines distribution with in-house manufacturing, offering cable and connector assembly, over-molding, cut-to-length, striping, cabling, twisting, extrusion, braiding, and planetary cabling. It also provides supply chain services such as inventory management, kitting, kanban/min-max, VMI programs, consignment and bonded inventory, and in-plant stores. Engineering support includes custom wire and cable design, cable assembly design, design review, and wire and cable engineered solutions. The firm describes its inventory as one of the most expansive in the industry and has expanded operations into Europe and opened a sales and distribution facility in Montreal.

FDH Electronics serves the aerospace, defense, and space markets, supplying commercial and defense manufacturers, subcontractors, commercial airlines, maintenance facilities (MROs), fixed-base operators (FBOs), OEMs, component manufacturers, and other distributors and brokers worldwide. Its product range covers interconnect, wire and cable, harness management, and electromechanical components, including 1553 Data Bus interconnect products, custom harnesses, high-performance aerospace-grade wire and cable, and high-frequency RF connectors.

The company positions itself as a single-source supply chain partner for OEM and aftermarket programs, emphasizing its status as a certified QPL manufacturer and its ability to meet or exceed MIL-STD-810 and RTCA/DO-160 environmental standards. Its value proposition centers on supply chain excellence, global reach, and the breadth of franchised product lines.
